text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Time flies like an arrow." Summer 
training camp is already over, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And a month later, the Mainichi Okan...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words!! It's FINALLY time for the 
decisive battle, YEEESSS!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El. As lively as ever today, I see~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're taking it easy today just like 
always!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However... Hehehe, I know the truth, yes! 
Over this summer, you've grown remarkably 
stronger once again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
THAT'S THE SPIRIT!! THAT'S WHAT I'M 
TALKING ABOOOOUT!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—And after this!! Let us meet on the stage 
of the "Mainichi Okan", YES!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, I hate to ruin your cool exit, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"We're going back to the same dorm room 
tonight anyway, and besides, we're sitting 
next to each other on the bus right now, 
aren't we~?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Just go with the flow! Feel the vibe, 
pleeease!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the summer training camp with 
Grass Wonder came to an end!
